title: Mastering Web Font Fallbacks: Ensure Rock-Solid UI Stability with Optimal CSS Typography
tweet: Prevent layout shifts & ensure consistent UI with smart web font fallback strategies. Learn how to craft resilient CSS typography stacks for superior user experience. #WebFonts #CSS #UITips
tip: To prevent disruptive layout shifts (CLS) and improve perceived performance, always define a robust font stack. Start with your desired web font, followed by a local font (if applicable), then generic system fonts matching the desired weight/style, and finally a generic family (serif, sans-serif, monospace). This provides progressive enhancement and ensures text is always readable, even if web fonts fail to load.
